system_deps: MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler for mujoco-py
install.notes: The fake backend is pure Python (SDK Python 3.10+) and needs none of these. The upstream environment needs gym, mujoco-py and MuJoCo 2.1 (conda_env.yml and README.md), but it also cannot be constructed at this pin because the package initializer imports a missing mimic_walker2d module, the configured lowmass XML is absent and the reference loader uses absolute paths outside the clone. No install was attempted and no real-gym or hardware path was run.
